line.a_turniej.text: Today is the great hopscotch tournament!

line.a_potrzebuje.text: I need eight pebbles for the game.

line.a_w_torebce.text: I have five pebbles in my bag. I counted them this morning and wrote a five on it.

line.a_trzy.text: One, two, three. Three pebbles, not enough!

line.a_a_piec.text: And the five in the bag? We don't need to count them again. We know there are five.

line.a_od_pieciu.text: We start from five and count on only the new pebbles. Touch them one by one.

line.a_szybciej.text: Five plus three equals eight. That's much quicker!

line.a_ramka.text: In the ten frame, five pebbles fill the whole top row.

line.a_dorzuc.text: Add three pebbles and say how many there are altogether.

line.a_piec_i_trzy.text: Five in the top row and three in the bottom row. Eight!

line.a_klasy.text: Let's play hopscotch! I'm standing on the six.

line.a_z_szostki.text: Squirrel will hop three more times. Which stone will she land on? Point to it.

line.a_z_szostki_nie.text: Count on from six: seven, eight, nine.

line.a_dziewiec.text: Seven, eight, nine! I'm on the nine!

line.b_ryby.text: I'm going fishing! I already have seven fish in my bucket.

line.b_od_siedmiu.text: There are seven in the bucket. Count on from seven, touching the new fish.

line.b_karta.text: Seven plus two equals... Which card fits? Point to it.

line.b_karta_nie.text: Start from seven and count on two fish.

line.b_na_turniej.text: We have the pebbles, and fish for supper too. Now let's run to the hopscotch tournament!

line.c_plac.text: How festive it is here! Flags, a tent and benches. This is where the tournament is!

line.c_zasady.text: Here are the tournament stones, all the way to the ten. Whoever hops to the ten wins!

line.c_moja_kolej.text: I'm hopping first! Keep your fingers crossed!

line.c_siodemka.text: Phew, I'm on the seven. The ten is still a little way off, and I have three hops left.

line.c_jeszcze_trzy.text: Squirrel is on the seven and will hop three more times. We don't count from the start, we count on from seven. Which stone will she land on? Point to it.

line.c_jeszcze_trzy_nie.text: Count on from the seven: eight, nine, ten.

line.c_dziesiec.text: Eight, nine, ten! I made it to the ten!

line.c_rownanie.text: Seven plus three equals ten. Squirrel has won the tournament!

line.c_wygrana.text: Well done, Squirrel! You knew you were on the seven, and you counted on only the new hops.

line.b_koniec.text: Counting on from a number you know is a clever trick!

line.p_start.text: Let's practise counting on! I have five games.

line.p_od_szesciu.text: There are six apples in the basket. Count on the new apples, touching them one by one.

line.p_z_czworki.text: You're on the four and you hop four more times. Where will you land? Point to it.

line.p_z_czworki_nie.text: Count on from four: five, six, seven, eight.

line.p_karta.text: Which card fits the empty place? Point to it.

line.p_karta_nie.text: Start from the first number and count on the second.

line.p_do_dziesieciu.text: There are eight pine cones in the frame. How many are missing to make ten? Point to the card.

line.p_do_dziesieciu_nie.text: Count the empty places in the frame.

line.p_dwa.text: Two! Eight and two make ten.

line.p_dziesiec.text: Five and five make ten, like two hands!

line.h_buty.text: There are shoes in the hallway.

line.h_szesc.text: Six shoes stand here. I've already counted them.

line.h_dwa_nowe.text: Guests came and left two more shoes. Count them on from six.

line.h_rodzice.text: Count on with your parents: from five, three more stairs up!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for the hopscotch tournament! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is a pebble from the hopscotch tournament. We got it when we learnt to count on.
